# Pi cohort recovery with 25 agents

The `pinned-pi-e4236190` cohort started at 10:55:32 p.m. PST on November 19,
2026, from Git base `c242741047d50427c4a9684176d48e0ec4b4bed7` in the 100latent
sandbox. Pi 1.5.2 ran on host-a (9 workers, x86-64), host-e (8 workers, arm64),
and host-f (8 workers, arm64). All used the `model-under-test` endpoint on host-a. Their first
prompts fell within 124 ms, with 9.17 seconds of overlap
across all 25 Pi session intervals measured by worker clocks.

The agents maintained two-file fixtures for ten Lit CLI, Git, and MCP
contract types. The pilot independently evaluated 25 contributions across
23 directories using the MIT-derived Lit executable. One agent retried after
the verifier rejected malformed JSON. The final tree passed all 25 executable cases and
`git fsck --full --strict`.

## Restart and concurrency

The same checked-in command ran three times with exit codes 74, 74, and 0.
The first stop followed a live reassignment and preceded recording its
receipt. The restarted controller adopted the same broker generation and
claim after one assignment submission. The second stop followed removal
of the temporary worker directory on host-a. The restarted controller
observed it already absent and reused the recorded denial checks.

| Exercise | Original PR | Replacement PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| host-e to host-a | [#471](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/471) | [#492](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/492) |
| Distinct agents on host-f | [#472](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/472) | [#493](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/493) |
| batch conflict | [#468](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/468) | [#494](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/494) |
| mcp conflict | [#470](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/470) | [#495](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/495) |

Both reassignments withdrew a live queue entry. The four stale
attempts were denied for publication and registration. Git independently
reproduced both conflicts. Each replacement kept the case already merged
by its peer.

## Integration and cleanup

GitHub recorded 29 successful pull-request checks and 25 verified native
merges. Four PRs retired. The audit matched each successful merge to
its exact Git parents, native merge events, and successful `merge_group`
check from Actions App 15368. The required check and empty bypass list
stayed in force. The temporary native build capacity was restored from
ten to one. No manual commit statuses appeared.

The final main commit was `8f92e68fbd49207804bf5503a7fb427ab3d5d192`. Cleanup restored the broker
configuration and ruleset, denied all 25 temporary identities, and removed
the three worker directories. The queue was empty, the broker was healthy,
and the verified receipts were preserved.

The 157 broker and runner regression tests passed on macOS and all three
lab hosts. The live run used recovery commit `3cdecf4` and the sandbox's
private lab adapter. Post-MIT upstream stayed black-box.
